title: moschosma dimidiatum
intro: Moschosma dimidiatum, commonly known as Half-moon sweet grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate symptoms of fever. The therapeutic actions of Moschosma dimidiatum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
